design.decision: Spread winners across suits when buying, and in play cash a winner in a new suit before running a long one.
design.opponent: Shown on the first win; opponents hold back their only stopper in your team's missing suit.
design.rationale: seed-rainbow-first (+8.0) shows that per-suit partial credit works where all-four thresholds swing. Compounding per new suit gives Rainbow a rare that pays about ×1.7 typically and ×2.07 at four suits, without seed-rainbow-x's all-or-nothing shape.
design.draftText: ×1.2 contract multiplier when your team wins its first trick with each suit

critic.concerns: Fires about three times every round (cut e-distinct-xmult at 100%), so it is close to a flat ×mult with little decision; the small factor compounds opaquely.
